item.title: The system
item.description: Everything on this page is an edit to the host repo, made as admin, followed by admin apply. The same files are in BOOMSTICK’s desktop/ directory, which the test VM uses. Packages Add a block to packages.txt: Edit this file: ~/arch/packages.txt # Desktop: sway and what it needs from the system. The rest of the # desktop -- terminal, bar, launcher, firefox, fonts, dotfiles -- comes # from Nix, with Home Manager and sway-home.

item.title: Nix and sway-home
item.description: Untested Nothing on this page has been run on a machine built by this book yet. The rest of the desktop is user’s, installed by user. user has no SSH key and no sudo, so get a shell as user from your admin session – a full login, with user’s own systemd user manager and session bus: Run this on the new machine: sudo machinectl shell user@ Not sudo -iu user: that gives a shell without a session bus, and Home Manager’s step that writes GNOME settings (dark mode, here) then starts a D-Bus daemon of its own from Nix, which looks for its configuration in /etc/dbus-1/ – where NixOS keeps it and Arch does not – and fails.
